# MATTER POISE

A U.S. AI-driven hardware R&D and manufacturing company.

## Investor Q&A
- [MATTER POISE Agent](https://flat-hill.github.io/matter-poise/agent/): published briefing, answer policy, evidence register and portable Skill.
- [Plain-text briefing](https://flat-hill.github.io/matter-poise/agent/brief.txt): self-contained dated knowledge and balanced response guidance.
- [Claims JSON](https://flat-hill.github.io/matter-poise/agent/claims.json): facts, management statements, assumptions and qualifications.
- [Skill](https://flat-hill.github.io/matter-poise/agent/SKILL.md): compatible-agent instructions.
- [Website](https://flat-hill.github.io/matter-poise/): products, BOM scenarios, commercial model, roadmap and financing plan.
- [Sources](https://flat-hill.github.io/matter-poise/sources.html): primary-source directory.
- [Human handoff](https://flat-hill.github.io/matter-poise/#bookroadshow): email meeting request.

AI assistance does not constitute team confirmation, verified traction, legal advice or a live team connection.
